descriptive.note: per-job seconds are excluded from determinism; their sum is compared with the census CPU and 4 x wall only as a plausibility reading

float_recomputation.method: exact rationals, explicit left-fold sums, correctly rounded conversions; bootstrap re-implemented from the seeding convention (sha256 'EXP-PFDR-bb0d26|boot|<cell>|main', 2000 resamples, randrange(k) k times, percentile indices int(0.025 B) and int(0.975 B) - 1)

arm_comparability_note: Each record carries one (p, a, b_coef, N, n) shared by its gap, 20 null and planted arms by construction (one record per (cell, block, c)); the checks above test that all arms are present and consistent with that n and curve, that every cell at the same bits uses the same curve for the same c (spec: cells at the same bits share the curve set), and the identities C >= n(n-1)/2 - D (sum_s binom(m_s,2) >= sum_s (m_s - 1)) and plant_C >= plant_internal (C is monotone under supersets). Regeneration of the arms on the recorded curve is J2b (recount-sample.json).
